outcome.message: Generated source only. No Git or workspace files written; run history and artifacts saved in Delta.

learned.requirement: Managers approve up to 5 consecutive days; Anything over 10 consecutive days needs the CEO. No more than 2 people out on the same team at once.
PTO accrues at about 1.67 days per month; Balances currently live in a Google Sheet called PTO Balances; Unused days above the carryover cap are forfeited on Dec 31.
Payroll runs on the 1st and 15th and needs a CSV export of approved days.
Internal tools should be a single-page web app in TypeScript with Google Workspace login; No new paid vendors; Employee data must not be exposed publicly; Keep the codebase small and tested.
Suggested data model: requests(id, employee_email, start_date, end_date, type, status, approver_email, created_at); Status values: pending, approved, denied, cancelled.
Brand: teal accent (#0F766E), Inter font, lots of white space; Status colors: pending amber, approved green, denied red; One primary action per screen.
At least one Customer Success person must be working at all times; She needs to see overlaps on a team calendar before approving.
Sales cannot take PTO during the last two weeks of each quarter without his approval.
